title: More ways to rework an image
summary:
New ways to transform images, plus less queueing and clearer model feedback in Enter.

ReImagine adds a mobile workflow for transforming one image with kontext or combining up to four with gptimage, with local history and sharing. The image model registry also gained nanobanana for image-to-image generation through Enter.

Seed, Flower, and Nectar detection now uses the updated subscription products. The tier panel reads the product name and daily Pollen amount from Polar rather than hardcoded values.

Enter requests now bypass the IP queue and its one-second interval. Flux image responses also report `flux` consistently in their tracking header, fixing an unrecognized-model error in Enter.

daily.title: ReImagine on mobile
daily.text: Transform an image with kontext or combine two to four images with gptimage. ReImagine keeps versions locally and lets you save or share the results.

daily.title: Nanobanana image transformations
daily.text: `nanobanana` was added for image-to-image generation through Enter, with a maximum side length of 2048 pixels. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).
